guidelines: Capstone demo-day summary written by one team member about their own contribution to a full software product built by the team.

criteria.name: Ownership
criteria.description: Clearly describes what this person owned and delivered, distinct from the team.

criteria.name: Product outcome
criteria.description: Explains the problem, the product and what was shipped.

criteria.name: Decisions and learning
criteria.description: Key decisions, trade-offs and what they would do differently.

criteria.name: Communication
criteria.description: Clear and concise for a hiring manager.
